simple.summary: הֲדַר (hădar) means magnificence First listed occurrence: Dan 4 27.

definitions.full: H1923. hadar [ הֲדַר ] noun [masculine] honour, majesty , of king; — emphatic הַדְרָא Dan 5:18 ; suffix הַדְרִי 4:27 ; 4:33 (where Behrm plausibly (after Theod.) הַדְרֵת [ הֲדַר ᵑ7 return ]).
